data.gender_notes: Aley is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Aley is derived from 'helle' meaning 'wanderer' and 'aleos' meaning 'little one'. This name was borne by several saints, including Saint Aley of Thessalonica and Saint Aley of Constantinople. The name Aley carries the meaning “Little one, wanderer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aley usually hope their child will grow to embody little one, wanderer and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aley total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
